{{Quote|Got word House Thul is smuggling in CryoBan weapons. Very illegal. Freeze you in three seconds flat.|translated=1|Aza Gundo describes the CryoBan problem on Alderaan|<ref name="TORFA" />}}
'''CryoBan rifles''' were a make of [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] which used [[CryoBan/Legends|CryoBan]] technology and were capable of freezing their targets rapidly. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], CryoBan rifles were [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] onto the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where they were illegal, by a [[CryoBan smuggling ring|smuggling ring]]. The weapons were delivered to the [[House of Thul]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]] involved in the [[Alderaan Civil War]] and backed by the Empire. House Thul's troops used the rifles in combat against troops of the rival, Republic&ndash;backed, [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] and the Republic troops fighting with them, causing many [[Death/Legends|casualties]]. After a large number of weapons had already been delivered to the planet, a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] named [[Aza Gundo]] became aware of the smuggling ring through pre&ndash;military connections he had, and the Republic successfully shut it down.<ref name="TORFA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Several days after the ring was shut down, Gundo enlisted the help of a Republic aligned individual to track down and destroy the remaining rifles on the planet. The individual traveled to the [[Organa Vinerium]], an area were Thul troops with CryoBan rifles were stationed, and killed at least five of them, taking their weapons to Gundo for destruction.<ref name="TORFA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
CryoBan rifles first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
